Interface Bank

public interface Bank
A bank holding at most one open account per holder name. A new bank has no accounts and zero reserves. Each bank instance owns independent state. Holder names use exact, case-sensitive equality; they are not trimmed or normalized. Null or blank names are invalid. Failed operations must not change the bank or its accounts. No persistence, interest, currency conversion or concurrency is required. Implement this interface in your own class.
Author:
JaroslavGr

  • Method Details

    • getNumberOfAccounts

      int getNumberOfAccounts()
      Returns the number of open accounts.
      Returns:
      the number of accounts registered with this bank

    • getTotalReserves

      BigDecimal getTotalReserves()
      Sums the current balances of all open accounts, including negative ones. Credit limits are not part of reserves. The result is zero for an empty bank and must reflect every successful deposit, withdrawal and closure.
      Returns:
      the non-null sum, compared numerically without regard to scale

    • getAllAccounts

      Collection<Account> getAllAccounts()
      Returns all open accounts, containing the same account objects returned by opening and lookup methods. Collection order is unspecified. The collection must not allow a caller to change the bank's membership: a defensive copy or an unmodifiable collection is acceptable. A snapshot or a live view is acceptable. Account balances remain mutable.
      Returns:
      a non-null collection of open accounts

    • openDebitAccount

      Account openDebitAccount(String accountHolderName)

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the new account, or null if the name is null, blank, or already belongs to an open account

    • openCreditAccount

      Account openCreditAccount(String accountHolderName, BigDecimal creditLimit)
      Opens an account with a fixed, non-negative credit limit and zero balance. A zero limit is allowed and behaves like a debit account.
      Parameters:
      accountHolderName - the exact holder name
      creditLimit - the maximum permitted debt; null and negative values are invalid
      Returns:
      the new account, or null if either argument is invalid or the holder already has an open account

    • closeAccount

      void closeAccount(Account account)
      Removes this exact account object from the bank, regardless of its balance. Its balance is then excluded from reserves and both lookups return null. The holder may open a new account, which must get a different number. Null, foreign and already closed accounts are ignored. Closing an account does not reset its balance; later operations on the detached account do not affect this bank. This is a simplified bookkeeping exercise.
      Parameters:
      account - the account object to close
